facts.area_damage: Eligible AreaAttack victims exclude native allies, every Kobolediator instance and self. Request native minecraft:mob_attack from this boss with float(configured ATTACK_DAMAGE double * double(native damage float)); profiles are1F or1.25F. Source direct/causing actor is the original boss, not debris. Hurt boolean is discarded, not proof of HP loss; native defenses/cooldowns/cancellation remain. Helper has no victim motion, status, healing, burn, invulnerability reset, %maxHP contribution or extra damage source. Shield disable is a separate post-call blocked predicate.

No current-target check at these callsites. Helper queries locked getEntityLivingBaseNearby(range,height,range,range), creates mobAttack(this), then requires server before hurt. Query retains native bbox/living/spherical/width rules. Native sector condition has distance<=range only in central angular branch; wrap-angle alternatives do not repeat that horizontal test. No added LOS/sort/hitset/extra radius or collapsed global-area attack.
facts.attack_selection: Native target selection registers priority1 HurtByNearestTargetGoal(empty exclusion array) and priority2 nearest Player with native visibility flag true; reuse those native predicates. Offensive InternalAttackGoal canUse needs alive current target, strict distance<range and required raw state. $1 adds nextFloat()*100F<16F then earthquake_cooldown<=0; $2 adds <9F then charge_cooldown<=0. RNG is consumed before cooldown checks, after base admission. State4 plain attack has no extra RNG/cooldown predicate; $4 range5/state6 has no extra canUse override. Selection order/priorities are native, not independent proc odds. No new HP, local LOS, shield, AWAKEN or Stage gate is added to these concrete goal canUse methods; locked dormant/sleep prerequisites remain separate.
facts.charge_damage: aiStep state6/server processes terrain first, then independently when global tickCount%4==0 queries LivingEntity in boss bbox.inflate(.5). Reject native allies,self,all Kobolediators. Native mobAttack(this) amount is float(configured ATTACK_DAMAGE) * .4F (float multiply after conversion, distinct from area/stomp double multiply then cast). No current-target/ground/hurt-result/terrain-success predicate admits damage. Store hurt result only for ground-dependent push; no status/heal/burn/shield-disabling helper here and no invulnerability reset.
facts.charge_debris: For admitted nextInt(6)==0/non-blockentity cell, construct locked Cm_Falling_Block life20 at block center BEFORE destroyBlock. Regardless destroy success, set velocity old + (boss.position-debris.position) componentwise multiplied by XZ(-1.2+independent nextDouble)/3 and Y(.2+Gaussian*.15), then add entity. Y coefficient multiplies the displacement; it is not simply additive upward. Native debris has no damage/placement/attack-owner payload; terrain change comes only from destroyBlock, charge hurt only from separate native contact path.
facts.charge_motion: Concrete $3.tick fully overrides StateGoal.tick. Only onGround: yaw=getYRot()*native float PI/180; facing(-sin(yaw),oldY,cos(yaw))*.7D + oldVelocity*.5D, then setDeltaMovement(computedX,currentOldY,computedZ). Intermediate computedY is discarded; vertical velocity is preserved. No super facing tick, target vector, body-yaw read, native knockback, local server/NoAI/hurt gate or extra damage call. This state6 self-motion is separate from charge contact damage and terrain breaking.
facts.charge_push: Charge contact hurt=true AND victim.onGround() invokes native push(dx/max(dx*dx+dz*dz,.001)*1.5F,.5D,dz/same*1.5F). Uses squared horizontal separation as denominator, not normalized distance; full push is absent for airborne victims. This is velocity addition through push, not knockback API or absolute setDeltaMovement; no explicit KBR read. Original hurt admission and owner remain unchanged.

It scans bbox.inflate(.5,.2,.5) from floor(bossY), requiring nonair, native canEntityDestroy, !REMNANT_IMMUNE and native onEntityDestroyBlock. Then nextInt(6)==0 AND !hasBlockEntity selects debris branch; RNG precedes block-entity test. Both paths destroyBlock(pos,false,this). Boolean OR accumulator is unused; failure does not gate debris add or contact damage. Helper adds no local side/hurt/NoAI/state gate, no drops or explosion, no damage source; native events/tags/pack rules remain authoritative.

facts.stomp_pull: Only hurt=true in spawnBlocks adds victim velocity: X=vx*(1-double(factor))*-4D, Z=vz*(1-double(factor))*-4D; factor computed earlier as1F-float(distance)/12F without a floor. With active distances2..10 this points inward relative to sample wave direction. Grounded victim addsY.15 else0. setDeltaMovement(oldVelocity.add(X,Y,Z)), not absolute replacement or native knockback API; no explicit KBR read. Damage request and this signed motion stay separate; repeated native successful samples can add motion without a new hitset.

Native body-yaw offsets, spread=PI*double(.25F), sampleCount=ceil(distance*spread), thetaRatio=i/(count-1) or.5 for one sample, floorXZ and floor(bbox.minY-.5) are retained. Render-block scan searches downward max30, AIR fallback does not cancel sample. Only server calls spawnBlocks, with original hitY+height and truncating int(bossY-height) lower search argument; render-block scan result is debris appearance, not its damage source. Samples are independent; no victim deduplication across cells/distances/ticks.
